info.title: SharpDrill — source-backed analysis of .NET code: exception flow, call diagrams and the project map.
info.description: Source-backed analysis of .NET code (Web APIs, console apps, libraries) for people and agents: which exceptions may escape an entry point, where they are caught or miscaught, Mermaid call diagrams and the MSBuild project map. Uses Roslyn and your installed .NET SDK; never builds or edits the analysed code.

commands.name: diagram
commands.description:
Mermaid call graph of one entry point, saved as Markdown (asks which one without --from).
[--from E] [--declared-only] [--max-depth N] [--max-nodes N] [--max-edges N] [--output F]

commands.name: exceptions
commands.description:
Exceptions along the call chains from each entry point: controller actions, Main or top-level
statements, and the public methods of a library project that nothing loaded references.
uncaught   (default) may leave an entry point: no catch on the way
caught     reaches a matching catch: where, and what the handler does
miscaught  passes through a try whose catch clauses do not match it
thrown     every explicit throw in source
[--from E] [--third-party] [--declared-only] [--locations] [--format msbuild] [--budget N]

commands.name: projects
commands.description:
Project reference tree with each project's framework, nullable settings and warning count.
[--mermaid [--output F]]

commands.name: skill
commands.description:
Install the agent skill in .github/skills and .claude/skills at the repository root, or with
--user in ~/.copilot/skills and ~/.claude/skills. No project load.

options.name: --from
options.description: One entry point: its ID, signature or a unique part of it, e.g. OrdersController.Get. Default: all.

options.name: --third-party
options.description:
exceptions uncaught: also list calls into NuGet packages and DLLs that no catch meets on the way
(not .NET itself, logging or Microsoft.Extensions).

options.name: --declared-only
options.description:
Stop at interface/virtual calls instead of following them into their source implementations
(followed steps are possibilities, never runtime facts).

options.name: --locations
options.description: exceptions: file:line for every step of each path.

options.name: --format
options.description:
exceptions: one build warning per finding, uncaught and miscaught unless a view is given.
SD0001 may escape an entry point, SD0002 may escape to a global exception handler, SD0003 miscaught,
SD0004 third-party call with no catch on the way, SD0005 leaves an async void method.

options.name: --budget
options.description: Analysis work limit (default 100000); raise it when the output says the run stopped early.

options.name: --mermaid
options.description: projects: also save the tree as a Mermaid diagram in Markdown.

options.name: --output
options.description:
New file for diagram or projects --mermaid; never overwrites. Default: ./diagrams_exports.
Loading:
--configuration NAME (default Debug), --framework TFM (for multi-target inputs), --exclude-generated,
--include-tests (test projects are skipped by default), --restore (always restore first; by default only when
packages are missing), --no-restore, --no-cache (analyse again even if nothing changed).

options.name: --version
options.description: Exit: 0 complete, 1 usable but with gaps/Unknown/limits, 2 invalid request or fatal, 130 cancelled.
